tips.mix: Mixing cardio and strength across the week keeps things balanced without overloading one system.
tips.recover: After a hard effort, leave room to recover — sleep, water, and an easier day.
tips.consistency: A steady half-hour most days usually beats rare all-out sessions.
tips.listen: These numbers are for inspiration. If something hurts or feels off, stop and check with a professional.
